subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “They learned that trees are not just beautiful.”?
options: In a city, a tree can be an umbrella, an air conditioner, and a quiet helper.
Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.
Clean air may be invisible, but the work to protect it must be regular and visible.
A responsible city must sometimes look less perfect in order to protect what people truly need.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「They learned that trees are not just beautiful. In a city, a tree can be an umbrella, an air conditioner, and a…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Clean air may be invisible, but the work to protect it must be regular and visible.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A responsible city must sometimes look less perfect in order to protect what people truly need.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They learned that trees are not just beautiful. In a city, a tree can be an umbrella, an air conditioner, and a quiet helper.」，答案為「In a city, a tree can be an umbrella, an air conditioner, and a quiet helper.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「In a city, a tree can be an umbrella, an air conditioner, and a quiet helper.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
